## Is this related to a problem?

Describe the problem or use case. Is this something you've run into? Do you see this affecting other users?

```typescript
// Example: What problem are you trying to solve?
import { wiz } from '@gouranga_samrat/log-wiz';

// Your use case here
```

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Proposed API (if applicable)

How would you like to use this feature? Show an example:

```typescript
// Example of desired API
import { wiz } from '@gouranga_samrat/log-wiz';

// How you'd like to use it
```

## Alternatives considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional context

- Why is this feature valuable?
- Will this add complexity to log-wiz?
- Are there breaking changes involved?
- Any related issues or discussions?

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues and found no duplicates
- [ ] I have checked the documentation and examples
- [ ] This feature aligns with log-wiz's principles (lightweight, zero-dependency, high-performance)
